owner_api.product_invocation: A collector already present in the user-started session observes post-original controller callbacks and hourly early-render selected Presents, then emits a new immutable receipt for each qualifying observation. The A37 acquisition adapter only reads those receipts while the user plays.
owner_api.pbp2_authority: none; the evidence owner cannot call the production seal while activation and scheduling are false

required_cases.proof_scope: actually observed positive current, negative exact change, open/visible controller, selected record/range present, authenticated WorldFrame selected-Present QPC join
actually observed negative current, positive exact change, open/visible controller, selected record/range present, authenticated WorldFrame selected-Present QPC join

case_output_handling: Invoke-A37PromotionAcquisition.ps1 passively watches immutable collector receipts from one user-controlled exact-a729 session. It authenticates stable bytes and the executable identity, retains the first independently selected Present for each required sign pair, and fails closed when either state was not observed before timeout.
required_join: controller open byte equals GUI-visible bit
post-materialization QPC is not after the WorldFrame selected Present
raw receipt selected-Present digest equals the production selector receipt
PBP2 is not emitted and activation remains false
legacy_client_driver_policy: isolated, disabled by default, and excluded from production acquisition; each requires the explicit EnableLegacyClientDriving opt-in switch
promotion_rule: A passing receipt closes only the raw controller spine. It cannot promote d74. Full exact runtime producers for every unavailable semantic field, a complete PBP2 selected-Present fixture, root Final/All and replay parity remain required before any latch or registry promotion.
